about.name: Oleksandr Oliinychenko
description: Mathematician by education. After graduating from Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv, worked for several years at the Institute of Mathematics of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. Later, I built a career in FMCG, progressing from sales manager to managing director of a distribution company.
In 2013, I moved to internet marketing. Launched and led the promotion of several educational projects. Since 2016, I've been doing what I really love - web development.
about.lastDescription: I have experience in both front-end and back-end development, as well as DevOps and usually strive to influence overall product development. My stack over the past 4 years includes... <0>Read more</0>

experience.title: My Latest Role Overview
text: In my most recent role in the event services industry, I started as part of a small team (3 devs). After the product launched, I gradually became the sole developer — taking full responsibility for evolving the platform over the last 4 years (see "Experience" section).

Beyond coding, I played a key role in shaping the product vision and enhancing the customer experience. I built a WordPress-based knowledge base, produced video tutorials using Synthesia, created custom reports with ApexCharts for company management and more.
experience.lastText: I also handled all UI/UX design for new features and websites myself — including <0>this one</0>.

vision.title: Vision for the Future
text: I’d like to keep my main focus on fullstack development and take full responsibility for the product — from idea and architecture to deployment and support.

I am primarily interested in product-oriented projects where I can maintain a strong connection with the end user. This allows me to build solutions that are both technically robust and strategically aligned with business goals.

kawunu.position: Full-Stack Developer (1 year Contract, 4 years Support)
description: Technologies: React, Angular, RxJs, Express.js, PostgreSQL, MUI, Angular Material Design, Playwright, Heroku.
Re-architected and rebuilt the taxi booking platform UI using React, introducing a consistent Material Design 2 design system.
Built from scratch a taxi order management platform for operators using Angular, improving order processing speed by 3x.
Designed and implemented a promo and discount system for taxi customers, enabling increasing marketing customer interactions by 2x.
Integrated address search and autocomplete using Google Places API, expanding supported customer locations by 300%.
Covered the 6 most complex business flows with E2E tests, validating full user-to-user scenarios.
Technologies: React, Next.js, React Native, Material UI, Hapi.js, Nest.js, PostgREST.js, PostgreSQL, Auth0, Heroku, Netlify.
Developed 3 React-based admin dashboards covering full event management workflows.
Migrated 200+ event management screens from Atlassian UI to MUI, reducing frontend development time by ~30%.
Implemented multi-admin workflows allowing organizers to manage events within shared accounts.
Designed a registration module for event hosts, onboarding 10% more organizers who required attendee tracking.
Built CSV/XLSX import-export pipelines for event data, reducing manual data entry workload by ~50%.
Built AWS S3-based file storage system for event resource libraries (documents, media, attachments).
Developed a custom event page editor, with ~25% of users adopting it immediately after release.
Rebuilt Google Ads campaigns, reducing customer acquisition cost by ~50%.

firstProjects.title: First Projects
firstProjects.text: The projects presented here were mainly created between 2016 and 2017, at the very beginning of my professional journey as a developer. Even then, for me it was important to create clean, detailed, and thoughtful interfaces.

currentWork.title: How I Work Now
currentWork.text1: Since the early stages of my career, there has been significant professional growth. The <0>source code</0> of this project serves as a testament to current standards of quality and architecture.
currentWork.text2: It's built on React and the MUI component library, uses React Router for navigation, and supports three languages through localization. Animations are handled by Motion, and code quality is maintained with Prettier and ESLint. The app is automatically deployed to GitHub Pages.
currentWork.text3: Additionally, I actively incorporate AI tools into my development workflow, which significantly increases productivity and allows me to often perform the work of a whole team.
